dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Excuse me, did you see an actor running away...

dialogues.speaker: Arnold
dialogues.text: Of course! How ridiculous! How could he waste such a great opportunity?

dialogues.speaker: Arnold
dialogues.text: If only it was me! I've always wanted to perform in a show, but I never got the chance...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They need to find someone to replace the guard who ran away.

dialogues.speaker: Arnold
dialogues.text: Well... I've seen them rehearse, but I'm still not a real actor...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But you are a real guard!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The other guy suddenly disappeared just as he got to "I am the last line of defense!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And now no one is going to save the kingdom.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As a guard, isn't it also your duty to protect the audience's wish to enjoy the play?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's always been your dream to perform on a stage! People are waiting! There's no time to hesitate!
